body.name: RepGraph
body.type: selection-set, graph, and target specification map
body.def: \(\operatorname{RepGraph}(\eta,B)\) is the purely graphical replacement specification constructed in \(\mathrm{def:basal\mbox{-}replacement}\); it contains a selection-node set, a basal selected DAG on \(V\dot\cup\widetilde S\), and direct-target sets, but no probability kernels.
